{{Spoiler}}

'''Warped stroganoff''' is the secret meal of the [[Warped Fungus|warped fungus]]. It heals {{Value|Warped Stroganoff|heals}} and grants {{EffectLink|Invisibility}} for {{Value|Warped Stroganoff|duration|effect=Invisibility}}.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/warped_stroganoff.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
Warped fungus, a [[steak]], dough, a milk bottle and a bowl. The recipe is taught by a [[Cooking Recipe]] sold by an Apprentice [[Cook]], who also sells 4 warped stroganoff for 1 [[obol]]. Unlike the other stroganoffs, it is meant to give the milk bottle's glass bottle back, but in 1.12.2-beta the advancement that returns it still names the recipe by an old ID, so the bottle is used up here too.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/mechanics/glass_bottle_from_crafting.json}}</ref>
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating it takes {{Value|Warped Stroganoff|eat_time}}, heals {{Value|Warped Stroganoff|heals}} and gives Invisibility for {{Value|Warped Stroganoff|duration|effect=Invisibility|format=clock}}. Making it grants ''Wait, you can make that?'' The bowl is given back.
